---
title: Glass Tide
type: concept
domain: golang
---

The note a cross-note heading link is written at. Its sections exist so a probe
can compare a link's fragment against the id this page really stamps, and it is
deliberately long: on a note that fits in one screen, "the reader arrived at the
section" is true before anything scrolls, and a check that cannot fail is worth
nothing.

Ballast paragraph A1: this passage exists to put distance between the headings of this note, so a jump to one of them has somewhere to travel and a failure to travel has somewhere to show.
